userManual.title: Connection Type Master — How It Works
userManual.desc1: Connection Type Master defines the categories of water connections available for billing.
userManual.desc2: 1. Add connection types (e.g. Residential, Commercial) along with their unique codes.
userManual.desc3: 2. Set the status of each connection type to Active or Inactive.
userManual.desc4: 3. Edit or delete existing connection types as needed.
userManual.warning: Always ensure the connection type is Active if it is currently being used for water billing.
